description: This file defines the 'Single' class which contains static methods for various financial calculations related to cash flow such as future value, periods, and interest rate calculations, as part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Single
classes.description: A class providing static methods for financial cash flow calculations such as future value, periods, and interest rate.

methods.name: futureValue
methods.description: Calculates the future value of an initial principal after applying a series of interest rates (schedule).

methods.name: periods
methods.description: Calculates the number of periods required for an investment to reach a specified future value given rate and present value.

methods.name: interestRate
methods.description: Calculates the interest rate required for an investment to grow to a specified future value over a number of periods.
